subject: Problem using which.items argument in the plot method

messages.author: 2d98f40c09e307a5
messages.subject: Problem using which.items argument in the plot method
parts:
I am trying to make a trace plot with only a few select items on it.   I can select and plot any number of items as long as the items are contiguous and begin with the first item.  That is to say that "which.items=1" and  "which.items=1:3" both work, but "which.items=2:3" does not.  Any thoughts?

>Ivec=9:12
> plot(m1.cia,type="trace",facet_items=F,theta_lim=c(-3,3),auto.key=F,which.items=Ivec)

Error: (list) object cannot be coerced to type 'integer'

> plot(m1.cia,type="trace",facet_items=F,theta_lim=c(-3,3),auto.key=F,which.items=1:12)

messages.subject: Re: Problem using which.items argument in the plot method

OK this is resolved.  I was using mirt package built under R version 3.1.2 in an R session using R version 3.1.1.  When I updated my R version, the problem goes away.

Thanks MLT
